operations.description: Load input components v2 = a2[1], v3 = a2[2], v4 = a2[3] before computing the squared length.
Compute squared length v5 = a2[0]^2 + v2^2 + v3^2 + v4^2 over all four components.
Compute reciprocal square root v6 = 1.0 / fsqrt(v5).
Apply one Newton-Raphson refinement step: v7 = (dword_5D8BF0 - v5 * v6 * v6) * dword_5D8BE0 * v6, producing the final scale factor.
Store normalized output a1[0..3] = a2[0..3] * v7 for all four components.
